subject.title: fix(agents): apply stale-run liveness check to aborted subagent orphan recovery

question: Must this external PR provide a redacted real exact-head gateway restart showing stale finalization and fresh recovery, or is the durable integration proof sufficient for this internal restart path?
rationale: Repository policy makes real behavior proof a merge gate for external code PRs, but the existing evidence exercises nearly every internal boundary and only the assigned owner can authorize an override for the mocked process boundaries.

options.title: Require live exact-head restart proof
options.body: Capture a redacted real gateway restart on 13adddcda26d9697d5e9a1821ed3fbc56888db7b showing the stale run becoming terminal, the fresh run resuming, and the resulting registry/task state.

options.title: Override with durable integration proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the real registry, SQLite/session-store, lifecycle, task, and liveness coverage despite mocked gateway transport and transcript reading.

recommendation.title: Require live exact-head restart proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted real gateway restart on 13adddcda26d9697d5e9a1821ed3fbc56888db7b showing the stale run becoming terminal, the fresh run resuming, and the resulting registry/task state.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and authored the latest durability and ownership design, so he is best positioned to judge whether the remaining live-proof gap is acceptable.
